question: Which Maratha statesman signed the Treaty of Bassein on December 31, 1802?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baji Rao Il**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Treaty of Bassein, (**Dec. 31, 1802), a pact between Baji Rao II,** the Maratha Peshwa of Poona (now Pune) in India, and the British.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Treaty of Bassein (Now called Vasai) was a pact signed on December 31, 1802, between the British East India Company and Baji Rao II, the Maratha Peshwa of Pune (Poona) in India after the Battle of Poona**.
 
• The treaty was a decisive step in the **dissolution of the Maratha Confederacy, which led to the East India Company’s usurpation of the Peshwa's territories in western India in 1818.**
 
• Wellesley was determined **to make the Company the paramount power in India**.
 
• He first extinguished the power of Tipu Sultan. Next, he paid his attention to the Marathas.
 
• He soon got an opportunity of interfering in the affairs of the Marathas
 
• Feeling desperate, the Peshwa sought** the alliance of the English and signed the treaty of Bassein, on December 31, 1802.**
